title: Agentic Model Trends and Implications for Compute Systems
summary: Agentic model trends, long-running tasks and agent scaling, with implications for asynchronous reinforcement learning, resource scheduling and AI infrastructure.
body:
## Research scope

This July 2025 research deck examines agentic model capabilities, stateful and long-running tasks, agent scaling and evaluation, and the implications for training and inference infrastructure.

## English and Chinese editions

Read either version below. The English edition contains 54 pages; the Chinese edition contains 53 pages.

- [English PDF](../posts/pdfs/agentic模型趋势及算力系统启示-gpt-eng.pdf)
